bine_over.desc: libpico external alltoall algorithm. This algorithm is used for small to medium messages

pairwise_ompi_over.desc: libpico pairwise algorithm, copied from Open MPI.

twill_group_over.desc: TWILL alltoall with group-interleaved (smooth weighted round-robin) schedule for tapered topologies. Works at any comm size. Env: TWILL_WINDOW (default 32), TWILL_MAP (rank->group file) or TWILL_GROUP (integer N = uniform groups of size N, or 'node' = node=group, default), TWILL_CACHE (default 1).

twill_random_over.desc: TWILL alltoall with a pseudorandom matching schedule (zero system info baseline). Works at any comm size. Env: TWILL_WINDOW (default 32), TWILL_SEED (shared seed), TWILL_CACHE (default 1).

twill_shift_over.desc: TWILL alltoall with identity relabeling: classic (s+t) mod P shift through the same windowed nonblocking engine (isolates schedule effect from engine effect). Works at any comm size. Env: TWILL_WINDOW (default 32), TWILL_CACHE (default 1).
